B.en: You indicated that you take vacations at home. Who are the people you would like to see and spend time with on your vacation?
cau: I am always busy with work so when I am on my vacation I just want to spend time with my family.
We do many things together.
We often go camping at the park nearby, it has a campsite with a great view.
We sometimes cook meals and watch some comedies.
Moreover, we also go to a restaurant nearby, we talk about our story while enjoying the food.
I feel very relaxed and happy with my family.
So, in the future, I still want to spend time with my family on a vacation.

B.en: Describle exactly what you did during the last vacation that you spent at home? Give me a description of what you did from the first to the last day. Talk about all the people you saw and everything that you did?
cau: I had a 3 days of vacation last month.
During my vacation.
I spend first day for clean my house, I made the bed, clean the floor, washed the clothes and blanket, I also clean the kitchen and bathroom.
Second day, I meet some old friend at a coffee shop.
We talk together about our job, we talked about our family and children, we discuss about plan in the future.
In nextday, I spent time to hang out with my family.
We went to the zoo and played many game.
After that , we went to favourite restaurant.
We ate so much because we were very hungry at that time.
It was a very nice vacation I got last month.

B.en: Could you tell me about unusual or unexpected experience you had during a vacation you had at home? What happened? Who was involved? And why was this expericence so memorable?
cau: I had an unusual experience last year.
It was 2 days vacation at home.
It was peak of hot summer.
And unfortunately, electric power of my house was suddenly damaged.
It was so awful for me without electric at that hot weather.
No fan, no air conditioner, no cooking, no televison..
I called to electric agent to fix the damage but It took to 2 days of repairing.
It took all my vacation
That was really terrible vacation I have to spend on it.

B.en: You indicated that you work I would like to know about your company. What kind of company is it? When was it founded? Where is it located? That products or services does it offer?
cau: I work for a large electronics company.
It's a global company that does business worldwide.
I have worked here for about 10 years.
My company is one of the most famous companies in cell phones and home appliances products.
It was founded in the late 1960s.
It was small when it first started, but now it is a huge enterprise.
The headquarters is located in Korea.
There are many factories and R&D centers in several countries, such as Vietnam, China, India,
These are some details about the company I work for.

B.en: Tell me about your daily routine at work. What kind of work do you engage in on a normal workday? What do you typically do as soon as you arrive at the office? Tell me everything about your day at work?
cau: Currently, I am working in the software development department.
My work schedule is quite flexible.
I usually arrive at the office around 8 or 9 AM.
First, I turn on my computer and check all my emails.
Then, I create a task list for everything I need to accomplish that day.
Typically, my working day is quite busy, as I have numerous tasks and projects to handle.
I have regular meetings with my colleagues every morning.
Additionally, I need to respond to and send emails to customers daily.
I often leave the office around 5 or 6 PM, but sometimes I have to work late if there are any urgent or critical issues.
This is my typical working day

B.en: Now, tell me about a project you did at work last week. What kind of project was it? How did it go? What did you have to do for the project? Did you have any meetings to attend for the project?
cau: I had a hard work schedule last week.
It was a new project that we had to finish within one week.
I had a lot of work to do on it.
I had to research new technologies to apply to the project.
I had to create many documents, many reports, join many meetings and update status to my boss.
It seemed like I was burnt out from overworking.
Fortunately, I finished the project on time .
Great feedback from my boss and the customer and project bonus for my contributions make me really happy.

B.en: Describle a family or a friend  you have What is he or she like? What is special about that person?
cau: I'd like to share a little about my parents.
My dad and mom are similar in some ways.
They are very family-oriented, showing great love for each other and their children.
They are willing to do anything to improve and support their family.
However, they also have some differences.
My dad enjoys football, but my mom doesn't.
My mom loves cats, while my dad prefers dogs.
Sometimes, they face conflicts in family life, but they always find a way to resolve them.
That's what my parents are like.
I love them deeply, and I hope to spend more time with them in the future.

B.en: Tell me about what you commonly do with your friends or family members when you get together with them?.
cau: I have some friends who live near my area.
On weekends, we often meet up at a coffee shop or restaurant.
We order drinks and food, and then we start chatting.
We talk about our jobs, our families, and our plans for the future.
Sometimes, we also visit an online game store and play our favorite games together.
They are like family to me—always there to support me when I feel down.
I truly cherish them and love them so much.

B.en: Talk about a time when you visted a friend or a family member recently. What did you do when you visited them? What was memorable about that visit? Tell me everything from beginning to end.
cau: Last New Year's Day, I finally returned to my hometown where my parents live.
When I visited them, I brought some gifts and also purchased some new furniture for their home.
We gathered together to celebrate the holiday.
We cooked a variety of traditional foods, especially making Chung cake, which is a traditional cake in my country for New Year's Day.
During the holiday, we enjoyed delicious meals, spent time together, visited neighbors, and attended various festivals.
We left our works behind to fully embrace and enjoy this special occasion.

B.en: Talk about a time when you visited  a friend or a family member recently. What did you do when you visited them? What was memorable about that visit? Tell me everything from beginning to end..
cau: I remember visiting my friend's house on last New Year's Day.
We had dinner together and have some drinks.
However, I drank too much and got drunk.
My stomach was upset and I had a light headache.
I felt like I was hanging on a tree and I could not walk normally.
I still had a hangover the next day.
It took me quite a long time to sober up.
Since then, I've told myself to be more careful when drinking.

B.en: I would like to know where you live. Can you describe your home to me? What does it look like? How many rooms does it have?
cau: I am living in an apartment with my family.
I have lived here for 5 years.

Our home is comfortably laid out with two bedrooms, a spacious living room, a well-equipped kitchen, two bathrooms, and a lovely balconyIn the living room, there are many funiture and home appliances.
The living room is the heart of our home, filled with essential furniture and modern appliances.
Connected to living room is the kitchen.
In included sink, a dining table and some cabinets.
We also have fridge, a microwave electric stove to make cooking easy and enjoyable.
In balcony, there is a washing machine and I also plant some trees there.
This is my home—a warm and inviting space where my family and I create wonderful memories every day.

B.en: What is your normal routine at home? Do you do housework everyday? What do you usually do on weekdays and what do you do on weekends?
cau: I try to clean my apartment whenever I can.
First, I sweep the floor and wipe the furniture.
Then, I clean the bathroom after taking a shower.
After meals, I wash the dishes and also take out the garbage and recycling.
On weekends, I do the laundry.
I put the clothes in the washing machine, then hang them to dry on the rack.
When they are dry, I fold the clothes and put them in the dresser.
I also clean the kitchen on weekends, I clean the microwave, cabinets, and coffee machine.
So, these are my routine work at home.

B.en: I would like to know where you live. Tell me the different rooms in your home, tell me about your favorite room in your home. What does it look like?.
cau: I live in an apartment.
My apartment has two bedrooms, one living room, and one kitchen.
There are also two bathrooms and one balcony.
I think my favorite room at home is the living room.
It has a television, a high-end soundbar speaker, a tea table, and a big sofa.
The sofa is the best place to rest and relax in the evening.
I usually lie on the sofa, surf the Internet, or listen to my favorite music after a tiring workday.
Sometimes I even fall asleep there and wake up the next morning.

B.en: Describle the home you lived in as a child. How was it different from the home you live in now?
cau: When I was a child, I lived with my parents in a small house in the countryside.
The house was old and simple, but it had a garden with many trees and vegetables.
There was also a pond where I used to go fishing.
Now I live in an apartment.
It's very different because there are no trees and no garden.
But the apartment is modern and comfortable.
Around my place, there are many facilities like a post office, a school, a market, and even a hospital.
So, the place I live now is very convenient, but it's totally different from the house where I lived when I was young.

B.en: Talk about a special memory you had at home with your family members. Perhaps, you had guests over or had a party of some sort. Tell me about that experience in detail.
cau: I attended the wedding party of my close friend recently.
It was the most unforgettable wedding I have ever been to.
The bride was so beautiful in white dress, and the groom looked very handsome in suit.
Many guests joined the party.
They ate, drank, sang songs, and gave their best wishes to the couple.
A live band played beautiful melodies throughout the meal, creating a wonderful atmosphere.
Overall, it was a very special and memorable experience for me.

B.en: There are always problem that happen in any home. Things break. Projects do not go as planned. Or people you live with do not cooperate. Tell me about some problems or issues that happened at your home?.
cau: I remember a problem I had at home last month.
The water pipe suddenly broke on the weekend, and we had no backup water.
Because of that, we couldn't cook, take a shower, wash our face, or even brush our teeth.
We had to order fast food from outside instead.
The pipe wasn't fixed until the next day, and it was such an inconvenient experience.
Since then, I've prepared a backup water source to avoid the same problem in the future.

B.en: What do people do on the internet? Do they play games, watch television or watch movies? Talk about all the things people do online?
cau: People do so many things on the internet these days.
They can send emails or check messages.
They post and share photos and information on social media such as Facebook or Twitter.
They also play online games, listen to music, or watch movies and video clips.
Additionally, they can do online shopping or even online banking.
With so many options available, the internet has become an essential part of daily life.

B.en: What do you usually do on the internet? Do you like to shop online? Do you like sharing videos with other people? Tell me about everything that you do online?
cau: I do many things on the internet every day.
At work, I send emails and check messages.
Sometimes, I use Google search to get information or data for my job.
When I have free time, I usually surf the internet on my cell phone.
I read online articles or check Facebook and Twitter.
I also listen to music and watch videos or movies on some apps like Netflix or YouTube.
Sometimes I do online shopping.
I usually buy toys for my children or some electronic equipment.
So, these are the things I do on the internet every day.

B.en: Tell me about our early experience of surfing the internet. What do you remember particularly about that experience?
cau: In my experience, the internet now is very different from before.
Back in the day, the internet connection was very slow.
It took a long time to do anything online.
When I logged into my email or opened a web page, I had to wait a lot—it was too slow.
At that time, using a computer was the only way to access the internet.
But now, the internet speed has improved so much.
When I load a web page or do something online, it responds almost immediately.
Also, there are many ways to access the internet now.
You can use a computer, or just a cell phone, and surf the internet wherever you want.
That's really great!

B.en: What do you like most about your phone? Maybe you like the camera or maybe you like certain applications. Tell me why you like those features and why?
cau: The thing I like most is that I can access the internet with my phone.
When I have internet on my phone, I can do so many things.
I can read online magazines, check Facebook, Twitter, or other social networks.
I can also play online games, listen to music, and watch videos or movies.
Plus, I can do online banking or shopping easily with my phone.
So, there are tons of things I can do, and that's what I like the most.

B.en: Tell me about the first phone you used? How was it different from the phone you use now?
cau: My first cell phone was a simple phone.
I can only used it to send messages and make phone calls.
The size of the phone was also very small.
But nowadays, phones have changed a lot.
They are called smartphones.
The size is much bigger, and they have high-quality cameras to take photos and videos.
Smartphones are like small computers with operating systems.
There are many apps, and we can also access the internet anytime.
So, cell phones have changed a lot from the past, and they have made a big difference in our modern life.

B.en: Tell me about a time when you had trouble while using your phone. What was the problem and how did you deal with it?.
cau: Currently, I'm using a smartphone that I bought a long time ago, so the battery is not good anymore.
But I don't have enough money to buy a new phone or replace the battery.
It's very inconvenient because sometimes I can not use my phone when it runs out of battery.
To deal with this, I always carry a power bank.
When my phone is low on battery, I charge it right away.
It's just a temporary solution, but it's necessary for me at this time.

B.en: You indicated in survey that you exchange text messages with friends. What kinds of text messages do you send? What are they about?.
cau: I usually keep in touch with my friends by exchanging text messages through an app called Facebook Messenger.
I talk about all kinds of things with my friends on that app.
First, we ask how each other is doing and do some catching up.
I also share pictures, video clips, and links with them.
We often talk about our work, our families, and our children.
Sometimes, we talk about trips or plans we want to go on.
So basically, there are tons of things I talk about with my friends through Facebook Messenger.

B.en: Tell me when and where you send text messages most offten. Plus, who do you exchange text messages with?
cau: I usually chat with my friends in the evening, after I finish all my daily work.
But sometimes, I also send text messages to my colleagues or customers while I'm working at the company.
I even send and reply to messages when I'm on the bus or in the car, using my cell phone.
So, that's when and where I usually send text messages.

B.en: Tell me about a memorable text message you got in the past. Who was it from and what was it about? What made that text message more memorable than others?
cau: I remember my last birthday.
I received a lot of birthday messages.
Many of my friends sent me congratulations and best wishes.
Some of them even sent me gift vouchers as presents and said nice things to me.
I was really surprised to get so many happy messages because I didn't expect that so many people would remember my birthday.
I was very happy, and I replied to each message one by one to thank them.

B.en: We sometimes have problems while sending text messages. Tell me about a time when you had trouble sending a text message. Start by giving me some background and then explain what you did to deal with the situation.
cau: I think I am a careful person, but sometimes I still make mistakes when sending text messages.
I remember having trouble recently when I sent a message to the wrong chat room.
It was a personal message with sensitive content, but I accidentally sent it to a work chat room.
I immediately recalled the message and apologized for my mistake.
Since then, I always double-check carefully before sending a message.
That was a really bad experience for me.

B.en: Tell me about the weather at where you live? What is the weather like in each season? Which seaon do you personally like?
cau: Vietnam has four distinct seasons: spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
The weather is very nice in spring and autumn.
The temperature is cool, and it's good for outdoor activities.
On the other hand, summer is extremely hot.
Moreover, sometimes it suddenly rains heavily with dangerous thunder.
Winter is the complete opposite.
It's freezing cold and there is no rain.
Of course, I like spring and autumn the most, for the reasons I mentioned before.

B.en: How is the weather today at where you are? Is it cold, is it warm? Talk about today's weather in detail.
cau: It is the middle of autumn today, but it's still very hot.
I can feel the high temperature even in the early morning.
The sky is clear, and I don't see any clouds.
According to the weather forecast, it will rain today, but I haven't seen any signs of rain so far.
I really hope the rain will come soon to make the weather cooler.

B.en: How is the weather today at where you are? Is it cold, is it warm? Talk about today's weather in detail.
cau: It is the beginning of winter today, and the weather is getting colder.
I can feel the cool air, especially in the early morning and at night.
The sky is a bit cloudy, and the wind is stronger than before.
According to the weather forecast, it might rain soon, but I haven't seen any rain so far.
I hope the weather stays cool and comfortable, not too cold.

B.en: How has the weather in your country changed over the years? What was the weather like when you were a child? How is it different from now?
cau: Vietnam still has four distinct seasons now.
But spring and summer have become longer, while winter and autumn have become shorter.
Also, summer seems much hotter and it has a lot of rain.
When it rains heavily, many places get flooded.
Sometimes people die, and many houses and fields are damaged by the summer rain.

B.en: Server weather conditions can do a lot of damage. Tell me about an experience you had related to severe weather conditions. Perhaps a city was flooded or maybe businesses or schools were closed due to heavy rain, that was the problem. How did people deal with the situation?
cau: I remember when a strong typhoon hit Vietnam last summer.
There were strong winds and heavy rain, and floods were everywhere.
Many people lost their lives, and many houses, cars, and fields were underwater.
It was a terrible situation, and it took a long time to recover from the damage.

B.en: You indicated in the survey that you like to go shopping.  Talk about stores or shopping centers in your country. What are they like? Describle them in detail.
cau: There are tons of stores in Vietnam.
They are everywhere these days, especially on crowded streets with heavy traffic.
One of the largest places to shop is outlet malls.
There are many types of stores in outlet malls.
You can buy food, clothes, furniture, electronic devices, and so on.
You can often get discounts or bargain for the price of the product you want to buy.
So, whether the store is small or large, there are plenty of stores in my country.

B.en: Where do you go and when do you go shopping for something? What do you buy when you go there?  What is special about that place?
cau: I go to various places to shop, such as outlet malls or department stores.
However, I prefer to shop online.
Nowadays, online shopping is very convenient in many ways.
It saves me time and energy when I buy the things I need.
When I want to buy food or clothes, I usually go to physical stores because I believe they should be checked directly before buying.
But for things like electronic tools, equipment, or books, I usually buy them online.
So, I go shopping whenever I need something, but overall, I prefer online shopping in person.

B.en: Think of your early memories of shopping. Was there a store you remember from you childhood? What did it look like and what were your impressions of that place?
cau: I remember there was a grocery store near my house when I was a kid.
Even though it was small, it had everything I needed.
The prices were also very cheap, and sometimes we could bargain to get a better deal.
I used to go there to buy candy, ice cream, or milk.
Sometimes I also bought toys or school supplies.
The shop owner was very friendly with customers.
That is one of my earliest memories of shopping.

B.en: What kinds of clothes do people in your country typically wear?  Do they wear different clothes for work or for play?
cau: Life is very modern now.
Fashion and style are everywhere and influence everyone.
Vietnamese people are the same — they are very stylish.
They like to follow the latest fashion trends and wear different clothes for each season.
Fashion and styles also change depending on the season.
Plus, people wear different types of clothes depending on where they are — at the office, going out with friends, or attending an event.
So, I can say that people in my country are very fashionable these days.

B.en: What kind of clothes do you like to wear personally? What kind of fashion style do you like? What are you wearing today?
cau: Today, I am wearing a black T-shirt and blue jeans.
This is also my usual style.
I like a simple and strong look.
I usually wear a T-shirt and jeans with sneakers.
Most of my clothes are white, blue, or black — very simple colors.
So, that's my style: simple and strong.

B.en: Fashion styles are always changing. Tell me about the kinds of clothes that were popular when you were younger. How are they different from what is popular now?
cau: Actually, when I was a kid, I didn't have enough clothes to wear.
I had to use old clothes from my brother and cousins.
Most of my friends were the same with me at that time.
So, fashion style when I was young was not very stylish.
But now, the quality of life has become much better.
There are many styles and fashion trends, and people always update themselves with the latest trends, following famous models.
I see people wearing beautiful and fashionable clothes everywhere.
So, fashion between the past and now is very different.

B.en: Tell me about the furniture you have in your home? Is there a piece of furniture that is your favorite?
cau: There are many types of furniture in my apartment.
In the living room, there is a television, a sofa, and a tea table.
In my bedroom, there is a bed, a wardrobe, and a study table with a bookshelf.
There is also a dressing table and some closets in my bedroom.
I think my favorite piece of furniture is the sofa.
I often talk and play with my family on the sofa.
Sometimes, I lie down and watch TV or have a snack there.
It is very convenient and comfortable.

B.en: Recycling is a common practive in many places Tell me about all the different kinds of items that you recycle
cau: I gather recyclables at home every day.
I put cans, bottles, plastic, paper, and glass into the recycling bin.
On average, I take them out once a week, usually on my way to work.
I think recycling is a good habit because it helps us reuse resources and protect the environment.

B.en: Tell me what recycling was like when you were a child. Was there a particular place to which you took out the recyclables? Describle what is was like and what you did in detail?
cau: When I was a child, I wasn't aware of the benefits of recycling, so I didn't usually do it.
I only gathered paper at school sometimes because my teacher asked me to.
But now I know recycling is a good habit, and I try to do it everywhere and whenever I can.
I recycle everything possible — likes cans, bottles, plastic, paper, glass, and even metals.

B.en: Many people try to eat healthy these days What kinds of food are healthy and why are they healthy for us?
cau: Nowadays, people understand food and health better than in the past, so they try to eat healthier.
First, they eat vegetables and fruits as often as they can, because these contain a lot of vitamins and fiber.
Next, they eat fish, meat, and beans, which are rich in protein.
Also, many people choose organic food whenever possible, since it is not grown with chemicals and so it is much healthier.
So, these are the types of food that are considered healthy.

B.en: Tell me how you found out about eating healthy. Did your family eat healthy when you were growing up? Describe to me in detail how you started to eat healthy?
cau: When I was a kid, my parents really cared about food and health.
They made me eat vegetables and fruits every day, and they also made me drink milk.
But when I grew older, I started choosing my own food.
Because I'm very busy on weekdays, I often eat fast food, even though I know it's not good for my health.
I think I should take care more about food that I eat to protect my health.

B.en: What is a popular dish in your country? What is special about the dish? Please describle that dish in detail?
cau: The most popular dish in Vietnam is Pho.
You can find it everywhere, from the North to the South, from inland to the islands.
Moreover, some Vietnamese people bring Pho when they go abroad, so now it is also well known in many countries around the world.
Pho is a type of noodle soup, usually made with beef broth and spices, topped with rice noodles and thinly sliced beef or chicken.
Some vegetables and onions are also added.
It has a very unique taste that you cannot find in any other dish.
When I travel, I always try Pho at that place to compare and find out where the best pho is.
And actually, I often eat Pho for breakfast.

B.en: Describe a healthy person you know? What makes that person healthy? Tell me everything about the thing that make that person healthier?
cau: My wife is a very healthy person.
She always makes time to work out or exercise whenever she can.
She goes to the gym twice a week, she usually goes swimming on weekends, and walks for about 30 minutes every morning.
Plus, she always eats healthy.
She says no to fast food or junk food.
She has a strong and beautiful body.
I really admire her and I try to follow her habits to become healthier.

B.en: Have you ever changed a habit or a certain lifestyle for your health? Maybe you started to work out or started to eat healthy. Tell me about that change you made?
cau: In the past, I was really lazy.
I ate too much and didn't exercise.
My body became very big and I was overweight.
I often got sick and had to go to the hospital more frequently.
At that point,
So I changed myself.
I cut down on the food I ate and did hard exercise every day.
Day by day, I felt the changes in my body.
I felt better inside, I lost some weight, and I got sick less often.
I will continue doing this to stay strong and healthy.

B.en: Talk a bout one thing that you did for your health in detail. That kind of impact did it have you your health? Give me all the details about the effect that had on your health
cau: I am a very busy person, so I don't have much time to take care of my health.
But I always spend 15 minutes every morning to do push-ups.
It's a short amount of exercise, but I think it has a big impact on my health.
After doing push-ups, I feel strong and full of energy for a long working day.
My body also gets a nice shape when I keep doing push-ups every day.
Push-ups are simple, but they have a big effect on my health.

B.en: I would like to know about restaurants in your country. What do typical restaurants look like? What kinds of food do they commonly offer?
cau: There are many kinds of restaurants in my country, such as fast food restaurants, traditional restaurants, and BBQ restaurants.
But these days, BBQ restaurants are the most popular and trending.
I can find them easily almost everywhere.
They serve many kinds of meat such as pork, beef, chicken, duck, and lamb.
There are also many types of seafood like shrimp, crab, fish, octopus, and squid.
It is so great when eat grilled meat with sause.
Among them, seafood BBQ usually attracts the largest number of diners.

B.en: Tell me about a restaurant you ate out recently, What kind of restaurant was it? What was their menu and what did you eat?  Who did you go with ? Did you like how the food tasted?
cau: I remember going to a seafood BBQ restaurant with my friend last week.
It's a well-known restaurant in my area.
The food is delicious, the price is cheap, and the service is also good.
There were many kinds of seafood, such as salmon, shrimp, crab, squid, and octopus.
We had to wait a lot of times because the restaurant is very crowded.
The meal was so tasty, .We enjoyed the food with some beer.
we were satisfied with this meals .
It was a great dinner.

B.en: Now, tell me about a restaurant you used to go to as a child. What was it like? What did you eat? Who did you go with? What do you remember most about that place? Tell me about that restaurant in as much detail as possible.
cau: I remember there was a fast food restaurant near my house when I was a kid.
It was a small restaurant, but it always had a lot of diners.
I used to go there on weekends with my parents.
They served many types of dishes, such as pizza, hamburgers, and Korean noodles
I usually ordered my favorite seafood pizza and a bottle of Coca-Cola.
The pizza tasted amazing.
But now, that restaurant has moved to another place, and I don't know where it is.
I really miss it and the delicious food of that restaurant.

B.en: How do busy working people usually get their meals on weekdays? Do they order food or goto restaurants. What do they usually do?
cau: People have become a lot busier than in the past.
Sometimes, they don't even have time to cook for themselves, so they eat out or order in much more often.
At the same time, people also care more about their health than before.
Even when they eat out, they think about eating healthy.
So, they tend to choose restaurants that offer healthy menus.
This has become a trend: people eat out more often, but they focus on healthier options.

B.en: Talk about gatherings or celebrations in your country? What do people do when they get together to celebrate things?
cau: In my country, people often go to restaurants for gatherings or celebrations.
They enjoy food and drinks with their friends.
During the celebration, they eat, drink, cheer together, and often have wine or beer.
They talk loudly and sometimes even sing together.
They leave all their work behind and enjoy this moment.
It makes their relationship closer and more intimate.

B.en: What did you do at your last gathering or celebration? What was the occasion? Give me all the details?
cau: A few weeks ago, I had a team-building event with my team members in my family's garden.
Some members went fishing, and some chased and caught chickens to prepare for lunch.
Since all of us are office workers, we were not good at cooking, so it was really hard for us to make a meal by ourselves.
However, we were good at teamwork and knew how to support each other well.
In the end, we had a delicious meal, and it turned into a meaningful day of gathering.
It was such a great occasion for our team.

B.en: Talk about a memorable incident that happened at a gathering or a celebration? Why was it memorable? What made it unforgettable?.
cau: I remember going to my friend's house at last his birthday party.
We had dinner together and had some drinks.
However I drank too much and got drunk.
My stomach was upset and I had a light headache.
I felt like hang on the tree and I could not walk normally.
I still had hangover the next day.
It took me quite a long to sober up.
Since then, I should be more careful when I'm drinking.

B.en: Tell me about how people get around in your country, Do they drive their own cars or take trains. What are some typical means of trainsportation to get around?
cau: There are various types of transportation in my country.
Some people take public buses or trains to get around the city, while others use their private cars.
When traveling to a faraway place, people can take a train or an airplane, but those are not very popular in Vietnam.
The most popular vehicle is the motorbike.
Most Vietnamese people use it as their private vehicle to go to work or travel around.
Currently, it is the most suitable option considering the road conditions, traffic, and lifestyle in Vietnam.

B.en: What means of transportation do you use to get around? Do you drive or take public transportation?
cau: I have one car and one motorbike, but I usually ride my bike to work or get around.
My workplace is not far from my home, so I use my bike to save gasoline and also to protect the environment.
When I go to my hometown or need to travel somewhere far, I drive my car instead, because it is much safer for long-distance trips.
So most of the time, I ride my bike to get around.

B.en: How did you travel when you were a child? Were the type of transportation different back then? Describe for me how people used to get around in your city or town?
cau: When I was a kid, transportation was not as good as it is now.
There were only a few cars and buses, and they were usually very old and ran very slowly.
It was inconvenient for people when they wanted to travel far.
But now, there are so many vehicles.
I can see a lot of cars, buses, and motorbikes moving on the road.
The road and traffic infrastructure have also become much better than in the past.
It is very convenient and easy to get from place to place.
Even though there are sometimes traffic jams, they don't have too much impact on people nowadays.

B.en: tell me about banks in your country. What do the typically look like? Where are they usually located?
cau: There are a lot of banks in Vietnam.
They can be government-owned, private, or foreign banks.
Most of them are located on crowded streets with heavy traffic.
There are usually ATMs outside where I can withdraw cash.
That's what banks in my country look like.

B.en: What do you do from the moment you walk into the bank until you walkout? Tell me everything about what goes on when you visit the bank?
cau: When I go to the bank, I first take a number and wait for my turn.
When the bank teller calls my number, I go to the counter and take care of my business.
Most often, I check my balance and make a wire transfer.
Sometimes I exchange foreign currency, and sometimes I apply for a loan.
So these are the things I usually do when I go to the bank.

B.en: Banks have definitely changed over time. Tell me about a bank you remember from your childhood. What did the bank look like? How was it defferent from banks today?
cau: In the past, I had to go to actual banks to do my banking.
But now, I can use mobile banking anytime I want.
Banking has become a lot easier than in the past.
It takes much less time and effort.
To do mobile banking, I just need to install the app and log in with my password and security code.
I most often make wire transfers through mobile banking.
So, I think mobile banking is one of the biggest changes.

B.en: Sometimes, problems can rise when you are at the bank. Tell me in detail about a problem you had that involved your bank. Maybe the bank was closed or perhaps the bank might have made some kind of problem. Tell me about how you solved that problem?
cau: I remember going to the bank to get a loan urgently.
But there were so many people at the bank.
First, I pulled out a number, but there were more than ten people waiting before me.
I waited and waited, but it was still not my turn.
In the end, I had to leave and go to another bank.
Since then, I try to avoid busy hours at the bank to save time and not affect my work.

B.en: Where do people in your country go to in their free time? Do they go to beaches? Do they go to parks or any other places? What are some popular locations that people go in their free time?
cau: In my country, people often gather or travel when they have free time.
When they gather, they usually go to a bar or a restaurant to eat and drink with their friends.
When they travel, they often go with family or friends to beautiful places like mountains, beaches, or parks.
Of course, some people just stay at home and take a rest in their free time.
So these are the common things people do in my country when they are free.

B.en: talk about your free time in the past. Did you have more free time or less free time back then? How was it different from your free time now?
cau: I had much more free time in the past when I was a student.
At that time, I only went to school for half a day, so I had the rest of the day free.
I usually hung out with my friends or played online games.
Sometimes, I also studied by myself.
But now, after I graduated, got a job, especially when I got married with two children, I'm very busy.
I rarely have free time.
Usually, I only have a little free time at the end of the day when my kids are asleep.
At that time, I just use my phone to read some news or online articles before going to bed.
So my free time now is very different from when I was a student.

B.en: Tell me about the last time you had some free time  When was it? What did you do ? Who did you spend time with?
cau: The last time I had free time was two weeks ago when I took my company's annual leave.
On the first day, I just stayed at home.
I listened to music, watched some movies, and enjoyed my meals.
On the next day, I took my child to the park, the zoo, and a children's play center.
The weather was so nice that my child enjoyed ourdoor activities
We felt very relaxed at that time.
Hopefully, I will have more free time in the future.

B.en: Tell me about some popular holiday in your country Where do people typically celebarte these holidays? What kinds of thing do they do to celebrate?
cau: There are three big holidays in Vietnam.
They are Lunar New Year's Day, Victory Day, and National Day.
On these days, people have time off from work and they do gathering together.
They visit their families in their hometowns, meet friends, neighbors, and cook special meals.
They also exchange lots of presents.
These holidays are important break times in the working year for people in my country.

B.en: Tell me about holiday memory from your childhood. Tell me where you were and what that place look like. Tell me everything that you remember from that holiday.
cau: I remember a memory from Lunar New Year's Day when I was a kid.
Like other children, I liked playing with fireworks during the holiday.
But one day, I had an accident — the firework exploded and burned my hand.
It was really painful, and I had to go to the hospital for surgery/ and bandage the wound.
Since that time, I never play with fireworks anymore.
It was a really bad experience.

B.en: Who do you live with? how do you divide up the housework amongst the people who live with you? Tell me about it in as much detailed as possible.
cau: I live in an apartment with my family.
I have lived here for 5 years.
Actually, we did not divide the housework clearly, we just try to clean our apartment whenever we can.
On weekdays, we sweep the floor and clean the bathroom after taking a shower.
After meals, I wash the dishes and also take out the garbage and recycling.
On weekend, I do a laundry, I put the clothes in the washing machine, then hang them to dry on the rack.
When they are dry, I fold the clothes and put them in the dresser.
We also clean the kitchen on weekends, I clean the microwave, cabinets, and coffee machine.
So these are our routine work at home.

B.en: Can you tell me about the most memorable house chore you have had? When was it? Why did it so memorable?
cau: I remember about cleaning my whole house last year.
My parents came to visit, so I had to make everything clean and nice.
It took me almost a whole day to finish!
I was so tired, but I felt proud when I saw how clean my house was.
That's why it was so memorable.

B.en: I also have my responsibilities at home. Please ask me three or four questions about my responsibilities?
cau: Hi, I'd like to ask you a few questions about your responsibilities at home.
First, what kind of house chores do you usually do?
How often do you do them?
Do you share your responsibilities with your family members?
And which house chore do you like or dislike the most?
That's all I want to ask.
Thank you.

cau: Hi there!
This is Toan.
I'm going to visit your city next month, and I need some help planning my trip.
First, can you tell me some nice places to visit there?
Also, what's the best way to get around the city — by bus, subway, or taxi?
Do you know any good restaurants or local food I should try?
And one more thing, what's the weather like these days?
I want to pack the right clothes.
Thanks a lot!
Talk to you soon.

B.en: Please tell me about the difference between jogging and another kind of sports. For example let's say the the other sport is Yoga. How are they different from each other? Which one do you think better your exercise?
cau: Jogging and yoga are very different from each other.
Jogging is a kind of outdoor exercise.
It helps me build strong legs and burn calories.
I usually sweat a lot when I jog.
On the other hand, yoga focus on stretching and relaxing the body.
